scope: All visible LeetCode Problemset topic tags, including non-algorithmic labels; not an exhaustive ontology of all conceivable algorithms.

groups.title: Data Structures and Representations
groups.description: Choose representations and invariants before selecting algorithms.

groups.title: Searching, Traversal, and Enumeration
groups.description: Explore candidate spaces systematically and prune work when possible.

groups.title: Dynamic Programming and Decision Making
groups.description: Use reuse, optimal substructure, local decisions, and competitive strategies.

groups.title: Sorting, Range Queries, and Monotonic Structures
groups.description: Order data, aggregate intervals, and exploit monotonic structure.

groups.title: Graph Algorithms and Connectivity
groups.description: Study connectivity, dependency ordering, shortest paths, and network optimisation.

groups.title: Mathematics, Bits, and String Algorithms
groups.description: Formalise counts, numeric properties, geometry, hashing, and text processing.

groups.title: Randomisation, Design, and Special Domains
groups.description: Capture specialised LeetCode topics outside classical algorithm paradigms.

topics.name: Array
topics.idea: An indexed sequence with constant-time positional access.
topics.example: Find the smallest element and explain the cost of scanning n entries.

topics.name: String
topics.idea: An ordered sequence of characters used in parsing and matching.
topics.example: Find the first repeated character in a short text.

topics.name: Hash Table
topics.idea: A key-to-slot mapping supporting expected efficient lookups.
topics.example: Count how frequently each order ID occurs, handling collisions.

topics.name: Matrix
topics.idea: A two-dimensional indexed collection used in grids and linear algebra.
topics.example: Find a path from the top-left to bottom-right cell.

topics.name: Linked List
topics.idea: A sequence represented by nodes with successor references.
topics.example: Reverse a singly linked list without allocating new nodes.

topics.name: Doubly-Linked List
topics.idea: A linked sequence with predecessor and successor pointers.
topics.example: Remove a known node in constant time by relinking neighbours.

topics.name: Stack
topics.idea: A last-in-first-out abstract data type.
topics.example: Verify that a string of parentheses is balanced.

topics.name: Queue
topics.idea: A first-in-first-out abstract data type.
topics.example: Process shop orders in arrival order.

topics.name: Heap (Priority Queue)
topics.idea: A priority-based structure supporting efficient minimum or maximum extraction.
topics.example: Return the next highest-priority pending order.

topics.name: Ordered Set
topics.idea: A unique-key set maintaining a comparison order.
topics.example: Find the closest stored value not less than a query.

topics.name: Tree
topics.idea: A connected, acyclic graph supporting hierarchical reasoning.
topics.example: Find the height of an organisation hierarchy.

topics.name: Binary Tree
topics.idea: A rooted tree in which each node has at most two children.
topics.example: Compute the maximum path depth recursively.

topics.name: Binary Search Tree
topics.idea: A binary tree governed by an ordered-key invariant.
topics.example: Validate a BST with a strict no-duplicates policy.

topics.name: Trie
topics.idea: A prefix-sharing tree for strings and sequences.
topics.math: p\preceq w\iff w\text{ begins with prefix }p
topics.example: Suggest all dictionary words with a given prefix.

topics.name: Graph Theory
topics.idea: Vertices and edges model general relationships and connectivity.
topics.example: Find whether two services are connected by any route.

topics.name: Data Stream
topics.idea: An online sequence whose state is updated as new items arrive.
topics.example: Maintain the median of incoming prices.

topics.name: Iterator
topics.idea: A stateful abstraction for visiting elements in sequence.
topics.example: Implement an iterator over an in-order tree traversal.

topics.name: Binary Search
topics.idea: Locate a boundary using a monotone predicate on an ordered domain.
topics.example: Find the first day when cumulative revenue meets a target.

topics.name: Two Pointers
topics.idea: Maintain two moving indices with a shared invariant.
topics.example: Find two numbers summing to a target in a sorted list.

topics.name: Sliding Window
topics.idea: Update a contiguous interval incrementally rather than rescanning it.
topics.example: Find the longest substring without duplicate characters.

topics.name: Depth-First Search
topics.idea: Explore one branch as deeply as possible before backtracking.
topics.example: Count connected islands in a grid.

topics.name: Breadth-First Search
topics.idea: Explore states by increasing path length in an unweighted graph.
topics.example: Find the minimum number of moves through an unweighted maze.

topics.name: Backtracking
topics.idea: Build partial solutions and abandon branches violating constraints.
topics.example: Generate all valid arrangements of three distinct objects.

topics.name: Recursion
topics.idea: Define a computation in terms of smaller instances with a base case.
topics.example: Compute factorial and explain the termination measure.

topics.name: Enumeration
topics.idea: Systematically inspect a finite or bounded space of candidates.
topics.example: Enumerate every subarray of a length-four array.

topics.name: Divide and Conquer
topics.idea: Split the problem into subproblems, solve them, then combine results.
topics.example: Find a majority element by merging subproblem results.

topics.name: Meet in the Middle
topics.idea: Split an exponential search into two smaller exhaustive searches.
topics.example: Find a subset close to a target sum by combining two half-sums.

topics.name: Quickselect
topics.idea: Use partitioning to locate an order statistic without fully sorting.
topics.example: Find the fifth smallest value in an unsorted array.

topics.name: Simulation
topics.idea: Evolve an explicit state according to a rule and input sequence.
topics.example: Simulate robot movements on a grid.

topics.name: Brainteaser
topics.idea: Use logical constraints and deductions rather than a fixed algorithmic template.
topics.example: Deduce the correct switch configuration from a set of clues.

topics.name: Dynamic Programming
topics.idea: Reuse results of overlapping subproblems according to a recurrence.
topics.example: Compute minimum cost to reach the end of a staircase.

topics.name: Memoization
topics.idea: Cache the outcome of repeated function calls on the same state.
topics.example: Compute Fibonacci values without revisiting solved calls.

topics.name: Greedy
topics.idea: Commit to locally attractive choices when an exchange proof supports global optimality.
topics.example: Schedule the most nonoverlapping intervals.

topics.name: Game Theory
topics.idea: Model strategic choices made by competing agents.
topics.example: Decide whether the first player wins a take-away game.

topics.name: Minimax
topics.idea: Optimise against an opponent's most damaging response.
topics.example: Choose a robust move in a small deterministic game tree.

topics.name: Bitmask
topics.idea: Encode subsets compactly in the bits of an integer.
topics.example: Enumerate subsets of six features with bit operations.

topics.name: Sorting
topics.idea: Reorder a collection according to a comparison rule.
topics.example: Sort transactions by amount while preserving stable ties.

topics.name: Merge Sort
topics.idea: Recursively sort halves and merge their ordered outputs.
topics.example: Count inversions while merging sorted halves.

topics.name: Counting Sort
topics.idea: Count discrete keys in a bounded domain to construct sorted output.
topics.example: Sort exam grades between zero and one hundred.

topics.name: Bucket Sort
topics.idea: Distribute keys into buckets, sort locally, and concatenate.
topics.example: Sort uniformly distributed values in the unit interval.

topics.name: Radix Sort
topics.idea: Sort positional digits with a stable subroutine.
topics.example: Sort fixed-width nonnegative identifiers digit by digit.

topics.name: Monotonic Stack
topics.idea: Maintain candidate indices whose values follow a monotonic invariant.
topics.example: Find the next greater element for each index.

topics.name: Monotonic Queue
topics.idea: Maintain an ordered deque of undominated candidates in a sliding window.
topics.example: Find each window maximum in linear time.

topics.name: Prefix Sum
topics.idea: Precompute cumulative aggregates for efficient interval queries.
topics.example: Count sales in any half-open date interval.

topics.name: Segment Tree
topics.idea: Store associative aggregates over a recursively partitioned range.
topics.example: Support mutable range sums over many queries.

topics.name: Binary Indexed Tree
topics.idea: Represent prefix aggregates through binary-indexed intervals.
topics.example: Update a value and query cumulative frequency efficiently.

topics.name: Sweep Line
topics.idea: Process geometric or time events in sorted order while maintaining active state.
topics.example: Count overlapping meeting intervals with start/end events.

topics.name: Union-Find
topics.idea: Maintain disjoint equivalence classes as edges or unions arrive.
topics.example: Count connected components after adding undirected links.

topics.name: Shortest Path
topics.idea: Minimise a path's total edge weight between vertices.
topics.example: Find the cheapest route in a weighted directed network.

topics.name: Topological Sort
topics.idea: Order a directed acyclic graph so dependencies precede consumers.
topics.example: Choose a valid compilation order for dependent modules.

topics.name: Minimum Spanning Tree
topics.idea: Connect all vertices with minimum total edge cost and no cycle.
topics.example: Connect office locations using the least total cable.

topics.name: Strongly Connected Component
topics.idea: Partition a directed graph by mutual reachability.
topics.example: Find circular dependency groups among services.

topics.name: Biconnected Component
topics.idea: Identify undirected graph blocks that cannot be disconnected by one internal articulation vertex.
topics.math: v\text{ is an articulation vertex}\iff c(G-v)>c(G)
topics.example: Find vulnerable junctions in a communication network.

topics.name: Eulerian Circuit
topics.idea: Traverse every edge exactly once and return to the starting vertex.
topics.example: Determine whether an undirected connected route network permits an Euler tour.

topics.name: Math
topics.idea: Turn a computational task into equations, inequalities or discrete structures.
topics.example: Solve a discrete arithmetic constraint using algebra.

topics.name: Number Theory
topics.idea: Reason about divisibility, modular arithmetic, primes, and gcd.
topics.example: Test divisibility or compute the greatest common divisor.

topics.name: Combinatorics
topics.idea: Count discrete arrangements, selections, and structures.
topics.example: Count ways to select k workers from n candidates.

topics.name: Probability and Statistics
topics.idea: Analyse uncertainty and infer quantities from samples.
topics.example: Estimate the probability of an event under conditional information.

topics.name: Geometry
topics.idea: Use coordinates, distances, orientation, and spatial relationships.
topics.example: Find the closest pair of planar points.

topics.name: Bit Manipulation
topics.idea: Use bitwise operators to encode and transform integer state.
topics.example: Determine whether the k-th bit is set.

topics.name: Hash Function
topics.idea: Map objects into compact signatures or storage buckets.
topics.example: Design a hash for strings and reason about collisions.

topics.name: Rolling Hash
topics.idea: Update a substring fingerprint using a fixed base and modulus.
topics.example: Compare many equal-length substrings efficiently with collision checks.

topics.name: String Matching
topics.idea: Find occurrences of a pattern inside a longer text.
topics.example: Locate all matches of a word in a document.

topics.name: Suffix Array
topics.idea: Sort all suffix starting positions lexicographically for text queries.
topics.example: Find repeated substrings in a long string.

topics.name: Counting
topics.idea: Turn logical predicates into occurrence counts or frequency aggregates.
topics.example: Count how many orders exceed a threshold.

topics.name: Randomized
topics.idea: Use random choices inside an algorithm to influence expected performance or output.
topics.example: Choose a pivot uniformly when partitioning an array.

topics.name: Reservoir Sampling
topics.idea: Maintain a uniform sample from a stream without knowing its final size.
topics.example: Select three uniform stream items with bounded memory.

topics.name: Rejection Sampling
topics.idea: Accept proposed random samples according to a target-to-proposal ratio.
topics.example: Sample from a target distribution using a known envelope Mq.

topics.name: Design
topics.idea: Implement an abstract data type that meets operational contracts and complexity targets.
topics.example: Design a small LRU cache with explicit invariants.

topics.name: Interactive
topics.idea: Choose queries based on replies while respecting an interaction limit.
topics.example: Discover a hidden value using bounded adaptive questions.

topics.name: Database
topics.idea: Express relational queries and transformations over tables.
topics.example: Find products with price above a threshold using SQL.

topics.name: Shell
topics.idea: Compose command-line utilities and streams as processing pipelines.
topics.example: Count matching lines in a streamed text file.

topics.name: Concurrency
topics.idea: Reason about overlapping operations, coordination, and shared-state correctness.
topics.example: Implement a counter that remains correct under parallel updates.
